svg.aria-label: Pareto fronts of accuracy against parameters and latency
svg.text: Accuracy against cost: Pareto fronts of our models and the WHAR Arena paper's 14 deep models

Cost measured on each dataset's real input (3-s windows), geometric mean over the 10 datasets. Solid line: front of all models; dashed: front of the paper's models alone. Bold labels sit on the overall front.
CPU latency per window, PyTorch eager, 1 thread, batch 1 (ms, log scale)
Latency depends on the implementation (unfused PyTorch on a desktop CPU), not only on the architecture. FLOPs are left out: the counter misses LSTM, FFT and scan work, so they are not comparable.
